Domain_Description: Controls related to Compliance
Control_Name: Consolidated Supervision of Internationally Active Banks
Control_Statement: Supervisors must apply the Basel Framework on a consolidated basis to internationally active banks to ensure comprehensive risk assessment and to prevent regulatory arbitrage.
Control_Objective: This framework will be applied on a consolidated basis to internationally active banks. Consolidated supervision is the best means to provide supervisors with a comprehensive view of risks and to reduce opportunities for regulatory arbitrage.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Compliance
Control_Statement: The Basel Framework shall also apply to all internationally active banks at every tier within a banking group, on a fully consolidated basis, or as an alternative through stand-alone application with full capital deductions of subsidiaries.
Control_Objective: The framework will also apply to all internationally active banks at every tier within a banking group, also on a fully consolidated basis... as an alternative to full sub-consolidation, the application of this framework to the stand-alone bank (ie on a basis that does not consolidate assets and liabilities of subsidiaries) would achieve the same objective, providing the full book value of any investments in subsidiaries and significant minority-owned stakes is deducted from the bank’s capital.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Compliance
Control_Name: Capital Exclusion of Significant Minority Investments
Control_Statement: Equity and regulatory investments in significant minority stakes must either be deducted or consolidated on a pro-rata basis based on national regulatory frameworks.
Control_Objective: Significant minority investments in banking, securities and other financial entities, where control does not exist, will be excluded from the banking group’s capital by deduction of the equity and other regulatory investments... Alternatively, such investments might be, under certain conditions, consolidated on a pro-rata basis. For example, pro rata consolidation may be appropriate for joint ventures or where the supervisor is satisfied that the parent is legally or de facto expected to support the entity on a proportionate basis only and the other significant shareholders have the means and the willingness to proportionately support it.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Name: Scope of Consolidation for Parent Holding Companies
Control_Statement: The scope of the Basel Framework must include any holding company that is the parent entity within a banking group to capture the risks of the entire group.
Control_Objective: The scope of application of the framework will include, on a fully consolidated basis, any holding company that is the parent entity within a banking group to ensure that it captures the risk of the whole banking group.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: All majority-owned or controlled financial entities, including banking and securities entities, must be fully consolidated unless specific regulatory exclusions apply.
Control_Objective: To the greatest extent possible, all banking and other relevant financial activities (both regulated and unregulated) conducted within a group containing an internationally active bank will be captured through consolidation. Thus, majority-owned or -controlled banking entities, securities entities (where subject to broadly similar regulation or where securities activities are deemed banking activities) and other financial entities should generally be fully consolidated.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: Global systemically important banks (G-SIBs) must be allocated into buckets of systemic importance with corresponding higher loss-absorbency requirements.
Control_Objective: Each year, the Committee runs the assessment and, if necessary, reallocates G-SIBs into different categories of systemic importance based on their scores and supervisory judgment. G-SIBs are allocated into equally sized buckets based on their scores of systemic importance, with varying levels of higher loss absorbency requirements applied to the different buckets.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Risk
Control_Name: Capital Adequacy Testing for Individual Banks
Control_Statement: Supervisors should verify that individual banks are adequately capitalized on a stand-alone basis in addition to consolidated capital adequacy requirements.
Control_Objective: Further, to supplement consolidated supervision, it is essential to ensure that capital recognised in capital adequacy measures is adequately distributed amongst legal entities of a banking group. Accordingly, supervisors should test that individual banks are adequately capitalised on a stand-alone basis.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Risk
Control_Statement: If subsidiaries are not consolidated for capital purposes, supervisors must ensure regulatory compliance for standalone capital adequacy and monitor corrections of capital shortfalls.
Control_Objective: If any majority-owned securities and other financial subsidiaries are not consolidated for capital purposes, all equity and other regulatory capital (or, if applicable, other total loss-absorbing capacity) investments in those entities attributable to the group will be deducted... Supervisors will ensure that an entity that is not consolidated and for which the capital investment is deducted meets regulatory capital requirements. Supervisors will monitor actions taken by the subsidiary to correct any capital shortfall and, if it is not corrected in a timely manner, the shortfall will also be deducted from the parent bank’s capital.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: The Board of Directors of the FI(s) must establish a comprehensive enterprise technology governance framework that defines leadership, organizational structures, and processes to ensure technology sustains and meets business strategies and objectives.
Control_Objective: a) The Board of Directors of the FI(s) are responsible to establish a comprehensive enterprise technology governance framework which defines the leadership, organizational structures and processes to ensure that the FI(s)’ technology sustains and extends the enterprise’s strategies and objectives.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: The governance framework must evaluate the current and future use of technology, direct the preparation and implementation of plans, and monitor compliance and performance against these plans.
Control_Objective: b) The primary objective of the technology governance framework is to evaluate the current and future use of technology, direct the preparation and implementation of plans and policies to ensure that use of technology meets business objectives and monitor compliance to policies and performance against the plans.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Name: Adoption of International Standards for Technology Governance
Control_Statement: FIs must adopt relevant aspects of international standards/best practices for effective enterprise technology governance.
Control_Objective: e) FI(s) are encouraged to adopt relevant aspects of international standards/ best practices for effective and efficient enterprise technology governance.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: The BoD must approve an IT Strategy covering vision, mission, stakeholders, processes, data processing, adoption of information security systems, and availability of IT resources.
Control_Objective: a) The BoD shall approve 'IT Strategy' covering overall design and plan of its operational framework including its vision and mission, stakeholders, business, workflow and processes, data processing, system access, adoption of best-in-class information security systems, practices and availability of IT resources.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Governance
Control_Statement: FIs must establish a Board IT Committee responsible for advising and reporting on the status of technology activities and digital initiatives.
Control_Objective: a) A Board IT Committee shall be constituted in all FI(s) except foreign banks, DFIs and Microfinance Banks. However, Microfinance Banks doing Branchless Banking (BB) operations shall also setup a Board IT Committee.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Security
Control_Statement: FIs must develop an information/cyber security management framework to systematically manage information/cybersecurity risks. The framework must cover asset identification, risk management, security controls, incident reporting, and industry collaboration.
Control_Objective: An information/cyber security management framework shall be developed to manage information/cyber security risks in a systematic and consistent manner. The framework, at minimum, shall include: identification and prioritization of critical information system assets; risk management process including risk identification, risk assessment and risk treatment; security controls implementation; cyber security action plan; incident reporting; security requirements and testing; risk monitoring and reporting; threat intelligence and industry collaboration.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Security
Control_Statement: FIs must ensure encryption at database, storage, and network transmission levels, based on data classification and sensitivity.
Control_Objective: The FI(s) shall ensure encryption at database level, storage level and during network transmission as per the classification and sensitivity of the data.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Access Control
Control_Statement: FIs must implement an effective process to manage user authentication and access control. This includes adopting an authentication mechanism based on the classification of information and ensuring compliance with an Acceptable Use Policy (AUP).
Control_Objective: The FI(s) shall have an effective process to manage user authentication and access control. For this purpose, appropriate user authentication mechanism commensurate with the classification of information to be accessed shall be selected. Users, who can access internal systems, shall be required to accept/acknowledge an Acceptable-Use Policy (AUP) document before using a system.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Operations
Control_Statement: FIs must establish patch management procedures to test patches in segregated environments and install them based on risk categorization and prioritization.
Control_Objective: Patch Management is a practice designed to proactively prevent the exploitation of vulnerabilities on IT devices. The FI(s) shall establish procedures to test patches in a segregated environment, and to install them when appropriate, including the identification, categorization, prioritization of security patches and their testing processes.

Domain_Description: Controls related to Operations
Control_Statement: FIs must establish procedures for the construction and maintenance of data centers aligned with international best practices.
Control_Objective: The FI(s) shall formulate procedures in line with best international standards for building and maintaining data center structures and operations.
